location.selector: #activity-3 #prob-3 (inline engine: bracket check in if conditions)

findings.claim: New, E5 (practice-feedback-policy 1.3): with the new statement check, a missing ")" in an if condition is reported on a later line, not the line to change. "if (input.equals("quit") {" on line 3 gives "Error, line 12: ')' expected ... check the brackets on line 12", and the same slip in the help test on line 9 also points at line 12. Activity 3 is exactly where a beginner types the double closing bracket of input.equals("quit")), so the most likely slip sends them to an unrelated line. javac reports this error on the condition's own line. The same engine locates a missing ")" inside an ordinary statement correctly (final-and-tostring line 11, enums line 7).
findings.recommendation: In the shared engine, report a missing ")" in an if, while or for condition at the end of the condition's line (the token before "{"), as the statement pass already does for ";"; if the line cannot be found, say "check the brackets of the if condition that starts on line N".
